title: ejecuta: run a command
summary: Run a command with its options in a child and report what happened.
hints: Child: `execvp(argv[1], &argv[1]);`, and if it returns, print the reason with `strerror(errno)` to standard error and `exit(1)`.
Parent: `wait(&status)`; the command was correct only if `WIFEXITED(status)` and `WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0`.
